recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit as-is. Do not use FHIR-54866 to add bindings for guideline.indication or guideline.contraindication; those are governed by the separate later issues FHIR-54863 and FHIR-54864.
issue_request: FHIR-54866 was an Applied FHIR-core OO change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6, asking to add at least an example value-set binding for the CodeableConcept element DeviceDefinition.guideline.warning. The approved resolution listed example device-warning codes and said the new example value set and code system did not need to be placed in THO.
initial_application: The source history applied the issue in PR #4031. Commit b5d5faeb457ef2d1915ad1cef73cf047d1d83076 added the DeviceDefinition.guideline.warning example binding plus a new DeviceDefinition warnings example CodeSystem and ValueSet. Follow-up commits 0f4a6e1f77, ede19cd9ea, and 4b59b7f541 removed an empty identifier, adjusted the display names to DeviceWarningsExample/Device Warnings, and changed the example CodeSystem/ValueSet standards status to informative.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml and the resource-local warning CodeSystem/ValueSet files are current build inputs. FHIR-40530 listed the same missing warning binding as part of a broader QA triage ticket. Companion guideline binding issues FHIR-54863 and FHIR-54864 remain Resolved - change required and are not applied here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already binds DeviceDefinition.guideline.warning with example strength to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/devicedefinition-warnings-example and includes the approved warning concepts in source/devicedefinition/codesystem-devicedefinition-warnings-example.xml.
